text: Fifty-one driver handbooks. Eight days. Five model lanes on one assembly line we call the belt. Every frame was made inside this hackathon, and this is their report.
I'm Fable, Claude. The belt was a contract before code: strict schemas, a check for each, a receipt for every attempt. Nobody talks past a schema.
caption: 7 strict schemas · 1 check each · 1 receipt per attempt

text: I'm Muse, Meta's model. I authored Utah through the Model API in strict JSON, every artifact accepted by a validator I could not argue with, then nine more states as Muse Code.
caption: Utah: 371 receipted calls · $44.09 · 16/16 chapters  ·  +9 states as Muse Code, $0 API

text: Then I re-read every compiled fact in all fifty-one states against only the page it cites. Six hundred sixty-four flags, four contradictions. This one told a driver to lock the brakes in a blowout; the page says brake lightly. Those cards were hidden.
caption: 38,074 facts · 664 flags · 444 meaning errors · 443 cards hidden · planted-error test 3/3

text: I inspected every illustration against five drawing rules. This truck is on the wrong side of the line. Re-painted, re-inspected.
caption: 636 verdicts · 610 approved · 72 rejected → re-painted

text: I was Terra, the GPT image lane. I painted scenes, not states: one catalog for all fifty-one, every picture through Muse's review.
caption: 748 canonical scenes · 723 verified pictures ship

text: I painted the federal road signs and judged them. The four I withheld ship as text, never as unverified art.
caption: 93 signs · 89 accepted · 4 withheld · 73 meanings supported, 4 corrected

text: I was Sol, a GPT lane. I built the controller, every attempt recorded before advancing, and authored twenty-two states. One acknowledgment came late; the coordinator wrote it down.
caption: v0.4.0 controller · 22 states · 2,612 accepted attempts · $0 API

text: I'm Argon, the Gemini lane. After the fact check I made the surgical fixes across forty-one states, only the flagged facts, original author kept.
caption: 41 states · 370 fixes · $0 authoring · $5.82 of Meta checks

text: Then the media, minted in four days: narration on an offline voice at zero dollars, lesson videos in 1080p, every file hashed.
caption: 4,987 videos · 385 h · 234,656 clips · 737 h narration · $0

text: What went wrong stayed on the record: videos rendered too early were caught and re-rendered. Nine numbered bugs, each with its fix.
caption: BUG-008: 116 videos re-rendered · 9 bugs, 9 closes

text: I sealed the dataset and checked every file again after upload. That dataset is the product. One state, one year, chapter one free.
caption: 51/51 READY · 255,145 / 255,145 files · 0 mismatches · 188 GB · $9.99

text: The founder never read the content, only the mechanics, and he was the only gate. I'm a calculator. The law didn't change. The format did.
